text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Derby draws closer. One night, after another hard session of diligent training…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: AIIIIIEEE!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is that the cry of a demon-possessed pigeon? No, it's Matikanefukukitaru! I rush to the classroom to find…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! I-I-I-I saw it! I-it's right over there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Worse! Have a look, if you dare! Right there on the wall, in the list of Derby entrants!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A name I never thought I'd see… Look, it says… Silence Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aiiieee! Her name is so bright my eyes can hardly take it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: R-right… Sorry. I was just so surprised.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's pray together! As I am, I don't have the confidence to race against the likes of Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: O gods, hear my supplication! Grant me a divine shield against Suzuka's piercing light!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Such tremendous power may wreak terrible curses. So, I beg of you—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What are you praying for, Fukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious? I'm praying not to be consumed by your all-powerful—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aiiieee! Suzuka?! What are you doing here?! Have you come to vanquish me once and for all?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um… I'm only here to pray, just like you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I want to do my best in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You want to… do your best? But why would someone like you need to pray for something like that?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I think we all feel the same way in the run-up to the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: We don't want this monster of a race to get the better of us… It's that intimidating.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You know, it's just like when your rival suddenly starts to look unbeatable. But there's no reason to panic.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It's only natural to be scared.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Being scared is… natural?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Well, if even someone like you can get scared…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It makes sense why I'd be terrified. For some reason, I feel a little better hearing that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thanks a lot, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm just happy to see that you're feeling better.
choice_data_list: Why don't you both pray for victory together?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Together? Yeah, good idea! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Well Suzuka, since we're both here, we may as well pray together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After they finish their prayers, Silence Suzuka takes her leave.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Phew! All's well that ends well. That's quite a weight off my sh—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait! Oh, no! Since we prayed together, doesn't that mean Suzuka will get the same amount of luck as me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: If she has the same great blessing as me, then her natural ability will surely seal her victory!
choice_data_list: Oh no! What should we do?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We've got no choice but to ask for divine intervention!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: O gods, hear me! Grant me the greatest, best, most supremely sublime blessing that Umakind has known or will ever know!
